title: Feed Skill Card Manifest
description: A skill card is a small, auditable skill that rides next to a post in a feed. The manifest is the contract: identity, what the card may do (declared per tool, at an honest tier), and how it is distributed. A card whose manifest is missing, invalid, or silent about a tool is denied by the gate - there is no default tier.

entry.description: Entrypoint the host invokes when a user taps the card.

tools.description: Every tool the card may call, declared once, each at exactly one tier. Tier follows effect, not the tool's name.

send_requires_human_approval.description: Normative: a conforming card never sets this to false. Send-tier tools are physically blocked until a human approves the exact request.

audit_log.description: Where the card's gate appends its audit events (JSON lines).

attach.description: How the card rides in a feed: attached to a post is the native form.

sandbox.description: The card runs locally in the host sandbox; the gate governs what may leave, the sandbox governs what may run.
